# City of Maple Ridge

> > Official website for Maple Ridge, BC, showcasing community events, festivals, and local activities that bring residents together throughout the year.

The City of Maple Ridge operates this municipal website to inform residents and visitors about community happenings, from seasonal celebrations to charity fundraisers. Key venues include Memorial Peace Park, Albion Fairgrounds, and Maple Ridge Library, hosting events that support local businesses, sustainability initiatives, and community wellness.

## Key Topics

- Maple Ridge
- Memorial Peace Park
- Albion Fairgrounds
- Maple Ridge Library
- Community events
- Family activities
- Winter Fest
- Charity fundraising
- Farm-to-table
- Local restaurants
- Sustainability initiatives
- Seniors programs
- Children's programs
- Seasonal festivals

## Seasonal Festivals & Celebrations

- [Christmas in the Park](https://www.mapleridge.ca/eservices/christmas-park): Annual Winter Fest tree lighting with Santa & Grinch at Maple Ridge
- [Fields of Flavours](https://www.mapleridge.ca/eservices/fields-flavours): Farm-to-table culinary festival featuring local restaurants & breweries
- [Pumpkin Cross Cycling Event](https://www.mapleridge.ca/explore-maple-ridge/festivals-events/pumpkin-cross-cycling-event): Halloween-themed cyclocross race with costumes at Albion Fairgrounds

## Charity & Fundraising Events

- [Coldest Night of the Year](https://www.mapleridge.ca/eservices/coldest-night-year): Charity fundraising walk supporting Ridge Church & Food for the Soul
- [Terry Fox Run](https://www.mapleridge.ca/explore-maple-ridge/festivals-events/terry-fox-run): Annual charity run at Albion Fairgrounds supporting cancer research

## Community Programs & Activities

- [Seniors Week](https://www.mapleridge.ca/eservices/seniors-week): Free fitness classes & activities for seniors at Leisure & Community Centres
- [FVRL Summer Storytime](https://www.mapleridge.ca/explore-maple-ridge/festivals-events/fvrl-summer-storytime): Children's summer library program at Memorial Peace Park & Fraser Room
- [Repair Cafe](https://www.mapleridge.ca/explore-maple-ridge/festivals-events/repair-cafe-4): Community sustainability event with volunteer repair at Maple Ridge Library
- [Maple Ridge Plant Exchange](https://www.mapleridge.ca/eservices/maple-ridge-plant-exchange): Free community gardening event at Memorial Peace Park
